tools.name: cometbackup_server_info
tools.description: Get the Comet Server version and which roles are enabled (storage, authentication, software build, constellation). Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/meta/version.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_users
tools.description: List the user account names on the Comet Server. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/list-users.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_user_groups
tools.description: List the user group names on the Comet Server (id to name). Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/user-groups/list.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_policies
tools.description: List the policy names on the Comet Server (id to name). Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/policies/list.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_recent_jobs
tools.description: List recent and still-running backup jobs across all users: status, start and end time, user, protected item and storage vault ids. Newest first is not guaranteed; sort by StartTime if needed. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/get-jobs-recent.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_user_jobs
tools.description: List the backup jobs of one user account. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/get-jobs-for-user (TargetUser).

tools.name: cometbackup_list_jobs_between
tools.description: List the backup jobs that ran from the start day to the end day (both included, UTC). Use it for failure reports over a period. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/get-jobs-for-date-range.

tools.name: cometbackup_get_job
tools.description: Get one backup job: status, times, retry count, user, protected item, storage vault, device and client version. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/get-job-properties.

tools.name: cometbackup_get_job_log
tools.description: Get the plain-text report log of one backup job, for example to see why it failed. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/get-job-log.

tools.name: cometbackup_get_server_stats
tools.description: Get the historical counts of buckets, users, devices, boosters and network devices on the Comet Server. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/meta/stats.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_live_devices
tools.description: List the devices connected to the Comet Server right now: user, device id, client version and platform. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/dispatcher/list-active.

tools.name: cometbackup_list_storage_buckets
tools.description: List the storage buckets with their owner, creation time and size in bytes. Keys and passwords are never returned. Comet API: POST /api/v1/admin/storage/list-buckets.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "cometbackup_list_storage_buckets" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cometbackup_server_info, cometbackup_list_users, cometbackup_list_user_groups, cometbackup_list_policies, cometbackup_list_recent_jobs, cometbackup_list_user_jobs, cometbackup_list_jobs_between, cometbackup_get_job, cometbackup_get_job_log, cometbackup_get_server_stats, cometbackup_list_live_devices, cometbackup_list_storage_buckets · Private data: cometbackup_list_recent_jobs, cometbackup_get_job, cometbackup_list_storage_buckets · Public sink: cometbackup_server_info, cometbackup_list_users, cometbackup_list_user_groups, cometbackup_list_policies, cometbackup_list_recent_jobs, cometbackup_list_user_jobs, cometbackup_list_jobs_between, cometbackup_get_job, cometbackup_get_job_log, cometbackup_get_server_stats, cometbackup_list_live_devices, cometbackup_list_storage_buckets.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
